sections.text: Introduction

Oil Burner Gun use for 
automiszing oil to combustion chamber 
This document out lines the major maintenance procedure steps P1 required for 
oil burner gun,.which must be performed on an annually bases or with any default 
in burner as indicated by Y1 in the title block .

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Hesham M. Hassan, reviewed by director eng. Saad Mostafa, and revised by quality 
control eng. Samir Abdel Gelil at EDEPCo., accepted by general director eng. Ali 
Al-Lithy and approved by eng. Mostafa Alam: Head Sector of Talkha Steam Power 
Station 2x210MW.

Update by eng. Fawzy Ahmed Basuoni, 
accepted by maintenance general director Mohmed Ali Abou Alnga and 
approved by eng. Farok Awod Ali Head Sector of Talkha steam power 
station 2 x 210 MW. revised by eng. Magdy Hgazey at MDEP Co., accepted by 
general director Samir Abdel-Gelil and approved by eng.: Mohmed Nageb 
Head Sector of Inspection& Quality control sector
This document is updated for 5 years review

Technical specification of these burner 
gun
Safety Precautions
Shut down the oil burner.

Isolate the 
oil burner gun mechanically as follows:
- In cooling re-circulation position.
- Slowly close the shut off valves to all three oil inlet/ outlet in the
following sequence (IIIIII)
- In operation position.
- Slowly close the shut off valves to all three oil inlet / outlet in the
following sequence (IIIIII)
- Shut down pressure air for oil burner gun.
- Isolate limit switch of oil burner gun.

items:
A work permit must be issued, the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes .... etc

following sequence (IIIIII)
- Shut down pressure air for oil burner gun.

to be Carried Out
Dismantle the oil burner gun from burner guide tube
Check the closing of valves inlets and outlets of the oil burner gun .

Before dismantle the oil burner gun you must measure the distance (L)
between burner gun tube edge and the end of the oil burner gun as in fig.
(2).

Check the

Prepare a tank to catch

Screw off the air connection (62) .

the burner guide tube (A).

gloves )

sections.text: Disassembly of the oil burner gun body parts
Disconnect the two pipes (33) , (34) of feeding and return oil.

By use air service in inlet (62) the piston will be in operation
position and we can loose cap nut (12) easy.
Shut off the air service.

Screw off bolts (58) which connected oil burner gun body (5) with needle
guide body (4).
Screw off the counter nut (56) and adjustable nut (57) .
Screw off the cap nut (12) and take out nozzle( 51) and atomizer (50) .

Release the 
O ring (55) which sealed between atomizer ( 50 ) and
inside tube ( 10 ) .
Take out the needle ( 47 ) from the oil burner gun body .

sections.text: Adjustment of oil burner gun needle
After assembly every part except cap nut (12) and nozzle (51).

Measure the distance (x) as in fig (1) and it must be 5mm when air service 
is in operation to air inlet (62)

If the distance is not correct, we do the following :
 * Shut off air service, * Loosen bolts (58), 
* Adjust from nuts (57), (56).

After final adjust we must light every bolts and nuts in cross sequence
well.

sections.text: Test of the oil burner gun

Test the oil burner gun from leakage by pressure air service
in inlet (II) and check leakage by using foam
forming agent and it forming
bubbles if there is leakage.

sections.text: Important: (In operation)

* If there is oil leakage from part (16 ) this indicates that the
piston rod sealing ring (43/2) is probably defective.

* If there is leakage of pressure air through of the opening (65) of
the pneumatic cylinder body (2). This indicates that the sealing ring of
pneumatic cylinder (42) is defective.
